label: lem:phi-range-roots-of-unity
title: Range of $\varphi$ contains $n$-th roots of unity
statement: Let $n : \mathbb{N}$ with $n \neq 0$, and let $\varphi : \mathrm{CyclotomicField}\,n\,\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{C}$ be any ring homomorphism (e.g.\ one obtained from Lemma~\ref{lem:cyclotomic-embed}).  Then for every $\xi \in \mathbb{C}$ with $\xi^n = 1$ we have $\xi \in \varphi.\mathrm{range}$.
proof:
From the hypothesis $n \neq 0$ we introduce the typeclass instance \verb|haveI : NeZero n := ⟨hn⟩|; this is what allows the cyclotomic-extension API on \verb|CyclotomicField n ℚ| to fire.

  Let $\zeta := $ \verb|IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta n ℚ (CyclotomicField n ℚ)|.  The fact that $\zeta$ is a primitive $n$-th root of unity is exactly \verb|IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec|, which states \verb|IsPrimitiveRoot (zeta n ℚ _) n| (this replaces the previous hand-wave ``by construction'').

  Apply \verb|IsPrimitiveRoot.map_of_injective| to $\zeta$ with the injective ring homomorphism $\varphi$ (injectivity of a ring homomorphism out of a field is automatic via \verb|RingHom.injective|): we obtain that $\varphi(\zeta)$ is a primitive $n$-th root of unity in $\mathbb{C}$.  Now given $\xi \in \mathbb{C}$ with $\xi^n = 1$, apply \verb|IsPrimitiveRoot.eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one| (with the primitive $n$-th root $\varphi(\zeta)$) to obtain an index $i < n$ with $\varphi(\zeta)^i = \xi$.  Then $\xi = \varphi(\zeta^i) \in \varphi.\mathrm{range}$ since ring homomorphisms preserve powers (\verb|map_pow|).
